summary.zh: 核对行程、事由与预算，生成一份清晰的登记草稿。
summary.en: Confirm itinerary, purpose and budget in a clear registration draft.

description.zh: 开发者声明三步表单，AI 从聊天中引导用户填写。确认后结果返回聊天，不会直接提交到财务系统。
description.en: A developer-defined three-step form guides the conversation. Confirmed information returns to chat without submitting to a finance system.

trialPrompt.zh: 使用三步差旅登记，帮我整理下周上海出差的行程和预算。请打开表单让我核对。
trialPrompt.en: Use three-step travel registration to organize my trip to Shanghai next week. Open the form so I can confirm the itinerary and budget.

setup.zh: 无需外部服务；预算以人民币填写。
setup.en: No external service is required. Budget is recorded in CNY.

changelog.zh: 修正核对确认项的中英文显示；目录详情增加只读步骤预览。
changelog.en: Fix the localized review confirmation label; add a read-only step preview to the listing.

description.zh: 核对目的地与出发日期。AI 可以从对话中带入已知信息。
description.en: Confirm the destination and departure date. AI can prefill details from the conversation.

description.zh: 填写出差事由与人民币预算；需要调整时可返回前一步。
description.en: Enter the purpose and budget in CNY. Return to the previous step to make changes.

description.zh: 勾选核对确认后，将登记信息发回当前聊天，不向财务系统提交。
description.en: Confirm the details to send the registration back to this chat. Nothing is submitted to a finance system.

summary.zh: 从故障描述到工单回执，连接已有的售后服务。
summary.en: Turn an equipment issue into a trackable ticket in an existing service.

description.zh: 用三步表单核对设备、故障和联系人，用户确认后由扩展提交测试 API。返回真实工单号，支持查询与幂等恢复。该样例需要独立测试服务和 SSH 隧道，不包含企业认证或生产派单能力。
description.en: Confirm the device, issue and contact in three steps, then submit to a test API after user confirmation. Returns a real ticket ID with lookup and idempotent recovery. Requires a separate test service and SSH tunnel; enterprise authentication and production dispatch are not included.

trialPrompt.zh: 使用设备售后工单，帮我报修 DEMO-FPGA-01，开机后调试日志中断。先检查服务连接，再打开表单让我确认。
trialPrompt.en: Use the equipment service desk to report DEMO-FPGA-01: debug logs stop after startup. Check the service connection, then open the form for my confirmation.

runtime.zh: 本机 Node 扩展，经 SSH 隧道访问远端 API
runtime.en: Local Node extension connecting to a remote API through an SSH tunnel

setup.zh: 授权读取自身配置；在扩展设置填写 serviceUrl（例如 http://127.0.0.1:18080），并保持测试服务隧道运行。
setup.en: Grant access to its own configuration, set serviceUrl (for example http://127.0.0.1:18080), and keep the SSH tunnel to the test service running.

changelog.zh: 首个测试目录版本，包含中英文表单、独立服务配置与四个业务操作。
changelog.en: Initial test catalog release with localized forms, service configuration and four operations.

description.zh: 填写设备编号，描述遇到的问题。此样例只使用虚构测试资料。
description.en: Enter a device ID and describe the issue. Use fictional test data in this sample.

description.zh: 选择常规或紧急处理，填写联系人或测试工号。服务地址在扩展设置中配置。
description.en: Choose normal or urgent priority and enter a contact or test user ID. Configure the service URL in extension settings.

description.zh: 核对后提交，并通过宿主的业务确认。扩展调用测试服务，返回真实工单号；结果不明时可查询确认。
description.en: Review and submit, then approve the host confirmation. The extension calls the test service and returns a real ticket ID; uncertain results can be looked up.
